versions.changelog: Dependency maintenance with unchanged canonical skill behavior and independently reviewed CLI 0.35.2 pin. Preserve existing permission boundaries and published data contracts.

Clarify supported Xerg skill installation paths and distribution verification while preserving explicit approval boundaries and the independently reviewed CLI 0.35.2 pin. Report a missing provider-generated card separately from artifact identity and security status.
Use independently reviewed CLI 0.35.2 with remote-command and archive corrections; restore remote OpenClaw guidance for approved targets and evidence paths.
Temporarily prohibit SSH, Railway and remote-config execution through the older reviewed CLI pin. Local audits remain available with existing approval boundaries.
Preserve the independently reviewed CLI 0.34.0 execution pin and existing approval boundaries. Canonical skill files remain unchanged.

Name the hosted home Fleet Overview while preserving the independently reviewed CLI 0.34.0 execution pin, installer 1.5.25, public-source SHA requirements and separate approval boundaries. This pinned CLI does not include the newly released OpenClaw database adapter. Preserve the existing static security result and accurate incomplete-analysis disclosure.

Harden agent setup with an exact reviewed CLI 0.34.0 pin and separate approvals for local analysis, workspace connection, payload preview and upload. Remove unused credential-path metadata and clarify restricted-environment and optional-observer boundaries. The pinned static scan reports 0 / LOW with zero findings; its incomplete-scan CAUTION status remains visible for known unresolved-reference false positives.

CLI 0.34.0 adds weekly workload allocation, cloud-agent grouping, and unpriced included-usage coverage. Event Payload v5 adds local run declarations and start/end timestamps while accepting versions 1 through 4. NDJSON ingestion preserves append-only event files. The canonical skill retains its separately reviewed CLI execution pin.

Profile-scoped analysis with source continuity, explicit registry recovery, local-only combined rollups, corrected zero-cost and residual accounting, and provenance-aware request detail. Preserve incompatible-policy comparison boundaries, private local evidence and the separately reviewed CLI execution version.

Pin the Agent Skills installer and require an operator-reviewed full repository commit SHA instead of selecting a mutable installer and repository head. Preserve interactive installation choices, separate permissions, and the independently reviewed CLI version. Without a reviewed revision, stop only installation or import an already-reviewed local folder after permission. Audit accounting, supported runtimes, observer behavior and public wire contracts are unchanged.

Pin Xerg skill execution and installation to the exact reviewed CLI version. Preserve the running version in package-runner recommendations instead of selecting a mutable tag, and keep upgrades explicit. Installation, local analysis, remote access and hosted writes retain separate permission; offline QM remains operator-provisioned. Audit accounting, supported runtimes, observer behavior and wire contracts are unchanged.

Publish Xerg 0.32.2 with runtime dependency updates for security and compatibility and corrected terminal-cell widths and wrapping for decomposed Hangul and Devanagari spacing marks. Grapheme boundaries, copyable commands, report structure, audit calculations, pricing, and public contracts are preserved.

Publish Xerg 0.32.1 with separated long terminal records, whole-field metadata packing, labeled copyable commands, and corrected multi-line error rendering while preserving machine-readable output and CLI behavior.

Publish Xerg 0.32.0 with optional observed parent-to-child agent delegation paths, latest-measurement source economics, clearer measurement decision summaries, and compatibility for earlier Push v7 and v6 payloads.

Publish Xerg 0.31.0 with compact and detailed semantic CLI reports, portable terminal formatting, shared command help, and byte-compatible machine output while preserving Push v7 and Event Payload v4.
Publish Xerg 0.30.0 with the canonical one-way Linear Optimization handoff guidance and synchronized public contracts while preserving existing CLI commands, Push v7, and Event Payload v4.

Publish Xerg 0.29.0 with the Fix with Xerg Optimization handoff, immutable validation summaries, and read-only hosted MCP retrieval while preserving existing CLI commands, Push v7, and Event Payload v4.
Publish Xerg 0.28.1 with fail-closed cross-runtime monetary CI thresholds, synchronized package identities, and current compatible dependencies while preserving Push v7 and Event Payload v4.

Publish Xerg 0.28.0 with corrected OpenClaw mixed-source accounting, transcript authority, explicit gateway-exclusion diagnostics, and comparison boundaries that prevent duplicate representation from appearing as savings, while preserving Push v7 and Event Payload v4.

Publish Xerg 0.27.4 with evidence-qualified verified savings, weekly Performance and Workflow economics, hosted admin-assigned runtime posture, and additive Push v7 workflow-waste and detector-versioned finding changes while preserving older Push v7, v6, and Event Payload v4 compatibility.
Publish Xerg 0.27.3 with department economics, seven-day comparable-source KPIs, Source Performance, and updated source branding while preserving CLI behavior, Push v7, and Event Payload v4.

Publish Xerg 0.27.2 with an authenticated cross-runtime Economic ledger, outcome-focused audit and comparison views, and non-monetary Signal investigation guidance while preserving CLI behavior, Push v7, and Event Payload v4.
Publish Xerg 0.27.1 with current compatible runtime, build, prompt, test, and security-analysis tooling while preserving the local-first workflow, Push v7, and Event Payload v4 contracts.
Improve dashboard audit coverage truth, comparison trust, series navigation, source workflows, and optional Push v7 signal labels while preserving older payload compatibility.
Clarify public release and QM setup documentation while preserving operator approval, version verification, no-secret, and no-live-collection boundaries.
Add MAAS band awareness, Push v7 coverage transparency, and Event Payload v4 while preserving Push v6 metering compatibility and keeping hosted billing effects disabled behind release gates.
Publish Xerg 0.25.3 with current compatible runtime and build dependencies plus precise full dates across the public changelog while preserving the local-first workflow and Push v6 contract.

Publish Xerg 0.25.2 with the unchanged CLI License Agreement and an npm-compliant custom-license label that fits the npm package sidebar while preserving the local-first workflow and Push v6 contract.
Publish Xerg 0.25.1 with the complete CLI License Agreement in the npm package and at xerg.ai/cli-license while preserving the existing local-first workflow and Push v6 contract.
Make activation status explicit from setup through first push, add recovery-aware onboarding, and publish the Event Payload v3 validation contract.
Add continuous Hermes observer liveness, strict prospective-workload preflight, and prominent aggregate-only warnings before economic conclusions across local and hosted Xerg surfaces.
Support Hermes Agent v0.20.1 with honest lower-bound terminal-byte measurements, local read-only source-integrity diagnostics, and backwards compatibility through Hermes v0.17.
Add durable activation-funnel instrumentation with a fixed, content-free execution-context envelope on explicit hosted pairing and push requests while local commands remain telemetry-free.
Group incremental hosted audit snapshots into deterministic series, clarify hosted snapshot IDs versus analysis fingerprints, and use corrected daily trend aggregation in Xerg-owned consumers.
Make SSH and Railway audit identity window-aware, normalize equivalent --since values, and document the deliberate pre-0.22 comparison and dedup boundary.
Clarify agent setup from npm with a non-interactive npx plus doctor --json path and explicit TTY-only init guidance.
Xerg 0.21.0 adds local evidence drill-down and xerg explain, argument-aware Claude Code diagnostics, additive Push v6 signal metrics, tier-aware Opus 5 pricing, and structured doctor JSON.
Evidence-strict 0.20.0: three monetary findings, seven neutral signals, explicit detector coverage and signal evidence, Push v6, and generic ingest v3.
Add production QM support, exact workspace-bound activation, and truthful unpriced economics.
Retires the provider-generated FOCUS importer, clarifies agent-runtime cost provenance and detector coverage, and preserves runtime wire versions 1–5.
Truthful Hermes audit coverage, request-level observer enrichment, and coverage-aware hosted comparisons.
Add browser-approved activation and secure first-audit setup.
Signup-first activation, secure CLI workspace replacement, universal agent setup, and dual skill discovery.
Adds current OpenClaw transcript tool evidence, isolated local OTLP trace capture, workload economics, and privacy-safe local reporting. Preserves Hermes state auditing and all hosted wire contracts.
Add Hermes v0.17+ state.db auditing, aggregate request-count reconciliation, and an optional local content-free mechanical observer.

Free hosted workspaces: Free plan (2 members, 30-day pushed history, 100 snapshots/month) with workspace API keys; Pro adds full history, unlimited pushes and members, Ask Xerg, hosted MCP, Slack, and policy drafts. xerg login accepts Free workspace keys, push errors explain member-limit and quota issues, successful pushes print a dashboard link, and @xerg/schemas gains the WorkspaceEntitlements contract.

0.7.0: Audits now flag detected source files that produce no included calls (count-only note, full paths in xerg doctor --verbose). Markdown reports gained the Notes section. New canonical finding-kind registry in @xerg/schemas completes taxonomy labels and powers hosted categorization.

0.6.0: full-dimension pricing (input/output/cache read/cache write) with a ~270-model catalog, cache and reasoning token extraction across OpenClaw/Claude Code/Hermes/Cursor, session-native waste detection (transcript-inferred retries, tool loops, context growth, cache churn, cadence-based idle), cost-per-outcome via the new xerg outcome command, and doctor --verbose extraction coverage.

0.5.8: OpenClaw audits now parse modern session transcripts (message.usage.input/output) and price zero-cost subscription calls via estimation, fixing all-zero spend reports. Adds claude-sonnet-4-6/opus-4-5/opus-4-6 pricing, excludes trajectory bundles from detection, clearer init cloud-setup errors, and staging-aware login.

0.5.7: quick-start commands now pin npx @xerg/cli@latest, the CLI warns on unsupported Node versions at startup, a non-blocking update notifier flags stale installs, and Node 26 is now supported (engines >=22).
